verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's platform docs state that bot management and WAF are 'built into the network and run on every request from day one,' implying Workers apps inherit these protections, but there is no detail on invisible challenge mechanics (e.g., Turnstile) or Workers-specific configuration, and no independent corroboration in the evidence pack. missing for 10: specifics on invisible/challenge-based bot protection mechanics, Workers-specific setup docs, and hands-on/independent verification.
